items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: Les Hite played in my band, yeah. Les Hite was my saxophone player

ctx.x: And some of the musicians that uh, were around then--I just wonder if you remember anything about, like, for instance, Les Hite--he played in your band, didn't he?

Les Hite played in my band, yeah. Les Hite was my saxophone player, and he...he's the cause of me getting Lionel 'cause when he left New York...uh, Chicago, I mean, he was playing with Lionel around there. Little school band, like, you know. When Les come out here, it was the first trip he made. He come out here with...uh...uh... some singer that had five pieces and [they were] on the Orpheum, [circuit] and when they got here, Les quit, and the other boy quit. There was two ...three of 'em quit, and I had both of…
Because you showed me that clipping where Lionel credited you with giving him his start in the band business.
